title: In-Lab Cancellation of Northgate Optical Eyewear Jobs
content:
**Northgate Optical in-lab cancellation.** An eyewear job in the lab is cancelled by the member's own confirmation, which records the cancellation and books the lens cancellation refund as one refund credit against the base-lens charge, returned to the original tender; the lab keeps the lab retention for the lens work already started.

The cancellation applies to a job whose status is in lab. Once confirmed, the job is cancelled as of that day and the lens cancellation refund stands against its base-lens charge.

## Conditions on the cancellation

The cancellation of an in-lab job is not confirmed until its frame charge carries the frame return refund.

The lab retention is worked out only after each light-adaptive, blue-light filtering or anti-reflective option charge on the job carries its option cancellation refund.

The lab retention is not worked out before the material upgrade charge of the job carries its material cancellation refund.

## The member's confirmation: `confirm_eyewear_cancellation_51323feb`

**Capability.** With this tool the member confirms the cancellation of their own eyewear job and accepts the refund of its lenses. One call marks the job cancelled as of today and books one cancellation refund credit against the job's base-lens charge, with the amount given, returned to the member's original tender; whatever is not refunded stays billed. The credit does not earn or take back Annual Reward.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it for the member (`unlock_user_discoverable_tool`) and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it (`call_user_discoverable_tool`), with the values the member services representative reads or states to them.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `optical_order_id` | the reference number of the member's eyewear job being cancelled, as the representative reads it to the member from the eyewear job lookup | identifier |
| `customer_id` | the member's customer reference number, as the representative reads it from the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| `source_txn_id` | the reference number of the job's base-lens charge being refunded, as the representative reads it from the job's charge and credit lookup | identifier |
| `lens_refund_usd` | the lens refund the member accepts, in USD, as the representative states it | plain number, no currency sign, 2 decimal places, not below 0; rounded half-to-even to 2 decimal places on booking |

**Return.** A receipt with `optical_order_id` (the job cancelled), `job_status` (`cancelled`), `closed_date` (the cancellation date, YYYY-MM-DD), `optical_txn_id` (the reference number of the lens refund credit), `source_txn_id` (the base-lens charge refunded), `amount` (the lens refund, USD with 2 decimal places), `credit_reason` (always `cancellation_refund`) and `status` (`confirmed` when the cancellation and the lens refund are recorded).
